feeds.description: A news project of UC Berkeley's Graduate School of Journalism. We cover Oakland crime, business, politics, education, and more.

feeds.title: East Bay Express
feeds.description: The East Bay Express is the local alternative to mainstream media. We seek to promote truth, expose wrongdoing, and give voice to the voiceless. We are dedicated to local arts and culture. Get News, arts, and dining coverage for Oakland, Berkeley, and the greater East Bay.

feeds.title: Visit Oakland | Things to Do, Hotels, Meetings & More
feeds.description: Oakland's got a personality of its own. Check out fun things to do, great accommodations, and fun ways to explore the City of Oakland here.

feeds.title: Oakland News Online
feeds.description: Oakland News Online covers topics such as Oakland news, food, politics and more.

feeds.title: Oakland Voices
feeds.description: Oakland Voices is The Oakland Tribune's 9-month program that trains East Bay residents to tell the stories of their neighborhoods. The Tribune created Oakland Voices as a vehicle for community members to become multimedia storytellers, and to be new voices directly shaping the coverage of this region.

feeds.title: Oakland Geology
feeds.description: The complete guide to Earth science and geology, focused on, near and under Oakland, California.

feeds.title: OakTalk
feeds.description: Make Oakland Better Now! is a grass-roots group of voters, volunteers, and policy advocates committed to improving the City of Oakland by focusing on public safety, public works, and responsible budgets.

feeds.title: 510Foodie
feeds.description: Food is my passion. I am passionate about every aspect of good food, whether it's shopping for ingredients at farmer's markets or produce markets, cooking for friends and family, or sharing a good meal at a restaurant. Obsessive? Perhaps, but my life is enriched by good food and part of that enjoyment stems from sharing this experience with others. Eating my way through the East Bay and beyond! I live to eat!

feeds.title: Our Oakland
feeds.description: Yep, this is my blog about Oakland. I blog about all sorts of Oakland-related things, from restaurants to photos to urban farming to the occasional rant post about politics. In short, whatever I feel like blogging about. But I love Oakland, which is why I write this blog.

feeds.title: Nik Sharma Cooks
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nik, This blog in more than one way represents my love for food and the beauty that surrounds it. The recipes that you will see here represent my experiences growing up in India and in the United States.

feeds.title: White Cleat Beat | An Oakland Athletics Fan Site | News, Blogs, Opinion and More
feeds.description: Welcome to White Cleat Beat, the Oakland Athletics news and opinions site brought to you by the FanSided Network. White Cleat Beat is dedicated to providing top-notch Athletics news, views, and original content. This site also serves as a community for like-minded fans to come together to catch up on the latest news and to discuss their passion.

feeds.title: Drake Talk Oakland | Making a difference in Oakland & beyond
feeds.description: Welcome to Drake Talk Oakland! Pamela Drake has been an political activist in Oakland and the Bay Area since 1973.
